svg.title: Scaled dot-product self-attention: Q, K, V projections and attention weight computation
svg.desc: Shows five tokens at the bottom, Q K V weight matrices projecting each token, the dot-product between Q of the query token and K of all tokens producing attention scores, softmax normalization, and the weighted sum of V vectors producing the output.
svg.text: Query token ("sat" is asking: what's relevant to me?)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are the Query, Key, and Value matrices in attention?')
sendPrompt('How is the attention score computed with softmax?')
sendPrompt('How does the weighted sum of values produce the attention output?')

svg.text: Output for "sat" = new contextual representation used by next layer
